description: This PHP source file 'resultsByStatus.php' is a script for generating test result reports in different formats (HTML, XLS, email), including initializing configurations, retrieving test metrics, and building report tables and spreadsheets for the TestLink test management system.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering external JavaScript-based tables used to display test results in the report.

classes.name: tlHTMLTable
classes.description: A class for rendering HTML tables for test results in different formats.

classes.name: PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Spreadsheet
classes.description: A class from PhpSpreadsheet library used to generate spreadsheets for XLS output.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns report arguments based on request parameters, including access rights and configuration.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the user interface object with labels, configurations, and access rights for the report.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves test execution metrics from the database based on the report type and updates the GUI object accordingly.

methods.name: createSpreadsheet
methods.description: Generates an Excel spreadsheet (.xls) report from the dataset, with options for emailing or downloading.

methods.name: buildMatrix
methods.description: Builds the test results matrix table object for HTML rendering, including columns and sorting/grouping.
